Ensures normalization by recording only the primary entity type in atomic string format. For example, value 'post' for indexing a post content.

plainFields.name: indexed_text
plainFields.description: Aggregated and normalized text used for full-text search - Combines title, body, and metadata fields in a canonical order for indexing. Implements core search requirements (requirement section 6). Stays fully normalized by representing only the atomic, canonical string. For example, concatenated post title and content, or comment body.

plainFields.name: indexed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this index entry was last generated/updated - Implements search freshness and incremental indexing needs. Maintains normalization by being a single timestamp per record. For example, updated whenever the associated entity changes.

models.name: discussionboard_search_histories
models.description:
Discussion board search histories - This implements the search analytics, audit, and user engagement/tracking requirements (see requirements 'audit & compliance logging' and 'search, tagging & discovery').

Business purpose: Records members' search actions, including terms searched and contextual metadata for system learning, personalization, and auditing. Maintains 3NF compliance by recording only normalized, atomic search event data. No aggregations or user-calculated fields present.

Usage example: Used for features like recent search re-surfacing, search analytics, and transparency/audit reporting.

Key relationships: Optionally references the member performing the search, and records search parameters and timestamps. No direct foreign keys in this table for loose coupling, but 'member_id' is provided as a reference for personalization/audit (references discussionboard_members.id).

Special behaviors: All data fully normalized; denormalized or aggregated reports must be built in separate materialized views.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Uniquely identifies each search history event.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to search-performing member's {@link discussionboard_members.id} - Implements user-specific audit and personalization requirements. No enforced FK constraint for privacy and audit integrity.

plainFields.name: search_terms
plainFields.description: Raw search query string(s) executed in this event - Implements the requirement for search auditing and analytics. Records the user's exact input, fully normalized as an atomic value per search event.

plainFields.name: search_filters
plainFields.description: Serialized search filters or metadata (e.g., tags, date ranges) - Implements search capability analytics; records in atomic (normalized) format only, never as precomputed lists or aggregates. Example: JSON or CSV with filter parameters.

plainFields.name: performed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this search was performed - Required by audit, analytics, and for supporting 'recent searches' features. 3NF compliance: single value per row, no rollup.

plainFields.name: result_count
plainFields.description: Number of results returned for this search event - Implements analytics requirement for search effectiveness, normalized with one row per search event. (May be used for user feedback and reporting.)

models.name: discussionboard_policies
models.description: Platform Policy Record - Implements the core platform policy requirements, giving a canonical, versioned record for all operational and behavioral policy rules. Policy data is strictly normalized and auditable, directly mapping to documentation requirements and board policy enforcement. Example: 'Community Guidelines v2.3' issued on a specific date. Integrates with audit logs and is referenced for compliance and moderator review. Only most recent is currently enforced, older remain for trace/audit.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each discussion board policy record.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Policy title, e.g. 'Community Guidelines' or 'Content Moderation Policy'. Maintains normalization, avoids duplication. Implements document clarity.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Full text body of the policy, in markdown or rich text. Implements requirement for accessible, canonical platform policy. For example, the text visible to all members or in legal export. Fully normalized: not duplicated in reports/notifications.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Version or revision string, e.g. 'v2.3'. Tracks updates and historic changes. Enables transparent history/audit. Example: used for date-based policy lookup or regulatory export.

plainFields.name: effective_at
plainFields.description: The date/time when the policy comes into effect. Enables lifecycle and audit tracing. Null when not yet active or for drafts. For example: a policy published for enforcement starting next month.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When a policy is superseded or withdrawn. Null if still current. Ensures that only one policy is enforced at a time and supports regulatory retention requirements.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of policy creation. Satisfies requirements for audit logging.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update. Ensures audit and policy lifecycle are tracked.

plainFields.name: created_by
plainFields.description: UUID of the member/moderator/admin who created this policy. Supports audit reporting, foreign key to actors table (exists in other component). Does not duplicate actor data.

models.name: discussionboard_policy_updates
models.description: Policy Update/Event Log - Implements transparent policy change and notification history. Records all updates to policies, enabling complete audit/compliance trail. Mapped directly to board transparency, legal, and user-notification requirements. Allows admins/moderators/members to see what was changed, when, and by whom. Enforces 3NF by separating update events/actors from the policy content itself.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each policy update record.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_policy_id
foreignFields.description: Target policy being updated. References {@link discussionboard_policies.id}, supporting referential integrity. Key in policy-update history. Maintains normalization in event/audit trails.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: Actor (admin/moderator/member) making the update (references IDs from respective actors tables—already defined in other components). Normalized and used for audit reporting, does not duplicate actor data.

plainFields.name: change_summary
plainFields.description: Summary description of what changed and why (for transparency and audit); e.g., 'Clarified spam definition; updated reporting workflow.' 3NF compliance: not embedded in policy or notification structures.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Event creation timestamp. Satisfies need for sequenced, auditable event logs.

models.name: discussionboard_community_guidelines
models.description: Community Guidelines Canonical Record - Fulfills the need for a canonical, structured storage of community guidelines, versioned with independent lifecycle tracking. Integrates with moderation and onboarding functions. Ensures canonical, up-to-date guidelines are referenceable without duplication. Only currently effective guideline is visible to members; previous versions are preserved for legal and compliance review.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for community guidelines.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Guideline section or doc title, e.g. 'Acceptable Use', 'Prohibited Behavior'. Atomic/normalized for search/display.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Full guideline content, markdown allowed. Canonical, structural, normalized; covers the specific rules detailed for users/moderators/auditors.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Version/revision tag, e.g. 'v2.0', '2025-07'. Enables traceable guideline life cycle. Normalized: not duplicated in child records.

plainFields.name: effective_at
plainFields.description: When this guideline text becomes authoritative. Enables future-dated guideline publication. Null for not-in-force or draft entries.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When this version is retired/superseded; null if active. Enforces policy history/lifecycle business rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when guideline section is created. Audit log compliance and historical integrity.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last change to guideline text. Complete update/audit trail. 3NF: kept atomic to avoid duplicate history.

plainFields.name: created_by
plainFields.description: UUID of creating admin or member (references ID in actors component). Enables history/audit trace, no actor info duplication.

event.planning:
## Error Scope
- Target Models: discussionboard_channels, discussionboard_configurations (Systematic), discussionboard_members, discussionboard_admins (Actors), discussionboard_boards, discussionboard_board_tags, discussionboard_board_categories, discussionboard_board_features (Boards)
- Unchanged Models: all others remain unmodified.
- Error Types: Duplicated unique index and GIN index on same field (not allowed – Prisma prohibits duplicate index types on a single field).

## Targeted Fixes (Minimal Correction)
- For each model, remove the GIN index for a field if a unique or plain index already exists on the same field. This preserves required uniqueness and business requirements, since full text/fuzzy search is not strictly necessary for a field that must be unique.
- Only one index per field per index type is permitted by Prisma – so for each duplicate pair (unique + GIN or plain + GIN), remove the GIN index on that field.

## Model-Specific Fix Plan
### Systematic:
- discussionboard_channels: Remove ginIndexes on `name` and `description` (because `name` is covered by unique, and to minimize redundancy).
- discussionboard_configurations: Remove ginIndexes on `config_key` (covered by unique).

### Actors:
- discussionboard_members: Remove ginIndexes on `username` (covered by unique).
- discussionboard_admins: Remove ginIndexes on `username` (covered by unique).

### Boards:
- discussionboard_boards: Remove ginIndexes on `name` (covered by unique).
- discussionboard_board_tags: Remove ginIndexes on `tag` (covered by plain index).
- discussionboard_board_categories: Remove ginIndexes on `name` (covered by unique).
- discussionboard_board_features: Remove ginIndexes on `feature_key` (covered by plain index).

## Minimal Output Scope
- Return: Only corrected models above
- Preserve: All other models untouched
- Output: All business logic and descriptions within corrected models preserved (except duplicate indexes removed)

## Cross-Model Impact
- Verify that uniqueness/search remains enforced for fields used for lookup and relationships
- All other model references preserved
- Business and documentation comments preserved
- No new errors introduced (remaining indexes validated)

## Impact Assessment
- No changed references or fields, only index clean-up.
- All other models remain unchanged and still refer to corrected models if needed.
- No data loss, as only redundant index definitions are removed.

models.name: discussionboard_channels
models.description:
Discussion Board Channels - Implements the system's multi-board partitioning requirement from the introduction and purpose documentation.

This model represents distinct logical channels within the overall discussion platform, each potentially covering a broad topic area or serving as an umbrella for more granular discussion boards. Each channel groups related sections or boards, allowing for flexible configuration, discoverability, and moderation boundaries.

Maintains 3NF by storing only channel-specific atomic data. For example, a platform could have channels such as 'Politics', 'Economics', each of which houses multiple sub-boards or sections.

Key relationships: Referenced by sections and boards for hierarchical organization.
Special behaviors: Supports soft deletion for audit trail, and can be toggled as visible or hidden in global navigation.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each discussion channel.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Channel name - Implements the naming structure requirement for top-level forum partitioning. Stores a unique, human-readable identifier for this channel (e.g., 'Politics', 'Economics'). Ensures normalization by separating channel name from any derived or display content. For example, 'International Affairs'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Channel description - Implements the metadata/context requirement. Provides a brief explanation of what the channel covers, aiding user navigation and discoverability. Maintains normalization by not mixing this with posts or boards' content. For example, 'Debate topics on domestic and world politics.'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp - Implements the audit/compliance requirement. Records when the channel was established. For example, '2023-11-21T14:00:00Z'.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Update timestamp - Audit/compliance requirement; indicates the last time channel info was modified. Enables efficient auditing and change detection.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Deletion timestamp (for soft-delete) - Enables reversible/historical auditing per policy requirements. Null if not deleted. Ensures normalization by not removing records outright. For example, '2024-01-01T09:00:00Z' or null.

plainFields.name: is_visible
plainFields.description: Visibility flag - Implements platform-wide configuration requirement. If false, channel is hidden from general navigation. Ensures atomic control over channel's appearance. For example, false when shutting down a channel for policy reasons.

models.name: discussionboard_sections
models.description:
Discussion Board Sections - Implements the hierarchical board structure requirement from the introduction and purpose and organizational requirements.

Each section represents a further subdivision within a channel, typically covering a subtopic or grouping related boards. Normalized to contain only atomic section-level data. Used to organize boards and topics for intuitive navigation and delegated moderation.

For example, the 'Economics' channel may contain the sections 'Macroeconomics', 'Microeconomics', and 'Policy'.

Key relationships: Contains a foreign key reference to its parent channel. Referenced by boards for sectional grouping.
Special behaviors: Supports position ordering for display, and soft deletion for recoverability.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each discussion section.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Parent channel's {@link discussionboard_channels.id}. Establishes the section's top-level grouping for platform navigation and moderation boundaries.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Section name - Implements the requirement for sub-board labeling. Human-readable label for the section (e.g., 'Macroeconomics'). Distinct per channel. Maintains normalization by separating label from display or content data.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Section description - Supports metadata/context requirements. Provides additional information about the section's focus. Kept nullable for brevity or when not required by policy. For example, 'All discussions related to global economic trends.'

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Section ordering position - Implements display order requirements for UI. Stored as an integer; allows reordering without changing IDs.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp - For audit/compliance tracking. Records the date/time the section was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Update timestamp - Last modification to section metadata. For change detection and audit trails.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-deletion timestamp. Null if not deleted, otherwise indicates when section was hidden for policy/compliance purposes.

plainFields.name: is_visible
plainFields.description: Visibility flag - Determines if section is displayed in navigation/search. Set false to temporarily hide. Implements atomic access and policy toggling requirement.

models.name: discussionboard_configurations
models.description:
System Configuration Registry - Implements the platform-wide settings/audit requirements.

Contains all global key-value configuration entries for the discussion board system (e.g., maintenance mode, password policy, default board behaviors). Fully normalized to ensure each config setting is atomic. Business logic implementation reads keys/values for runtime system behavior.

Key relationships: No foreign keys—self-contained for architectural separation.
Special behaviors: Supports type safety enforcement and versioned auditing.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each configuration record.

plainFields.name: config_key
plainFields.description: Configuration key - Implements requirement for named config registry entries; e.g., 'maintenance_mode', 'max_post_length'. Ensures each config parameter is individually addressable. Unique for the schema.

plainFields.name: config_value
plainFields.description: Configuration value - Stores actual config data, always as a string for normalization across boolean, numeric, text settings. For example: 'true', '2048', 'Welcome to the board!'.

plainFields.name: value_type
plainFields.description: Value type - Implements explicit type tracking requirement; e.g., 'boolean', 'int', 'string', 'datetime'. Separates data from type for normalization and safety.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Config description - Documents the purpose/usage of each config; assists admins and devs. For example, 'Enables or disables new user signups.'. Not shown to regular members.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for the configuration entry. Supports auditing and compliance logging.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last updated timestamp for the entry. Aids in config change tracking.

models.name: discussionboard_audit_logs
models.description:
System Audit Log - Implements the audit/compliance logging requirement.

Stores all significant system-level and user-led actions related to policy enforcement, administrative changes, and moderation outcomes, as required by operational and regulatory guidelines. Keeps normalized, atomic records for actions, actors, and metadata. Used for retrospective investigations, compliance audits, and appeals analysis.

Key relationships: Optionally references member/admin records in Actors component for actor_id.
Special behaviors: NEVER soft-delete; logs are permanent as required by compliance. Large volume/readonly design for performance.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each audit log record.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to actor (member/moderator/admin) who performed the action. Links to discussionboard_members, discussionboard_moderators, or discussionboard_admins in Actors component. Null for system or anonymous events. Ensures normalization by referencing, never storing actor names.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of action logged (e.g., 'POST_EDIT', 'USER_BAN', 'CONFIG_UPDATE', 'REPORT_ESCALATE'). Implements detailed event catalog for traceability. Normalized string values.

plainFields.name: action_scope
plainFields.description: Scope of the affected resource (e.g., 'post', 'comment', 'user', 'system'). Supports multi-entity audit coverage. Maintains normalization by not embedding resource details here.

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: ID of the affected resource (may refer to post, comment, config, etc. Schema-enforced by scope and audit logic). Atomic, polymorphic reference. Null if not applicable (e.g., system-level events).

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: Optional additional context/parameters for this log entry in serialized (e.g., JSON) format. For example, change diff, before/after values. Maintains normalization by never duplicating structural data. Kept as string for DB-agnosticism.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for the audit log event. Immutable; required for all entries. Forms the timeline basis for compliance reporting.

models.name: discussionboard_settings
models.description:
Lightweight System Settings - Implements per-section or user-overrideable parameters for the platform.

Configured as a separate table from configurations for localized, frequently-overridden, or member-facing settings (e.g., default notification preferences, custom display toggles). Normalized to link each setting either globally or to a logical owner (e.g., section, member).

Key relationships: May reference sections, members, or be system-global.
Special behaviors: Settings can be inherited or overridden per the type/owner.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each settings record.

foreignFields.name: section_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to a section ({@link discussionboard_sections.id}) for section-level settings. Null for global/system settings. Ensures normalization by not repeating setting values per section without context.

plainFields.name: setting_key
plainFields.description: Settings key - Unique identifier for this parameter; e.g., 'default_sort', 'theme_mode'. Implements settings registry requirement; atomic per entry.

plainFields.name: setting_value
plainFields.description: Settings value - String representation of the current setting. Maintains normalization without mixing with configuration data.

plainFields.name: owner_type
plainFields.description: Owner type - Implements scope-separation requirement. Defines if this setting is global, per-section, or per-member; e.g., 'global', 'section', 'member'. Required for scope enforcement.

plainFields.name: owner_id
plainFields.description: Optional reference to a board member or other owner. Null for global or section-scoped settings. Normalized for privacy and audit reasons.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of this setting, for admin UI or developer documentation. Not displayed to general members. For example, 'Sets the default sort order for new posts in this section.'

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the setting entry was created. Required for audit and configuration traceability.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for last modification to this record. Aids auditing and change notifications.

models.name: discussionboard_members
models.description:
Discussion Board Member Entity - Implements the user/member business entity requirement for the Actors domain.

This model stores registered user accounts who can participate in posts and comments, report content, and manage their profile. Maintains strict 3NF normalization: profile data, role assignments, and history are separated into respective tables. For example, the 'discussionboard_member_profiles' entity links here by foreign key for extended details.

Key relationships: one-to-one/optional with discussionboard_member_profiles, one-to-many with discussionboard_member_histories, and references to role assignment tables. Core for authentication and authorization.
Special behaviors: Email must be unique, username must be unique within the platform, soft deletion supported.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the discussion board member.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Member's email address - Implements user identification and notification requirements. Used for login and notification triggers. Ensures 3NF: not duplicated elsewhere. For example, 'jane.doe@example.com'. Unique constraint enforced.

plainFields.name: username
plainFields.description: Unique username chosen by the member - Implements the requirement for member identity display and mention system. Not null, unique within system. For example, 'policy_watcher'.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication - Directly maps authentication requirement. Enforces normalization: hash stored here only. Value is not the plaintext password. For example, a bcrypt hash string.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of account creation - Required for audit trail. Used in user onboarding and compliance logging. Always set at account creation. For example, 2024-07-22T15:15:48+09:00.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of the most recent update to the member record. Tracks profile/account changes per audit requirements. Updated on any change to member data.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp - Implements platform's right to erasure and retention policy. Null if not deleted; set to deletion time if deleted.

models.name: discussionboard_moderators
models.description:
Discussion Board Moderator Assignment Entity - Implements the role assignment requirement for moderators. 

This model records which members are assigned moderator rights. Each row represents a member with granted moderator privileges, enforcing permission control and auditability per requirements in 02_discussionboard_user_roles_and_journeys.md. Maintains 3NF by referencing members via foreign key.

Key relationships: FK to discussionboard_members (each moderator is a member), log of when and by whom the privilege was granted. Used for authorization checks and auditing moderation actions.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for moderator assignment.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link discussionboard_members.id} who is assigned as moderator. Fulfills moderator assignment requirement.

foreignFields.name: granted_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin's {@link discussionboard_admins.id} who granted moderator rights. Fulfills the admin-controlled assignment or revocation of moderator status.

plainFields.name: granted_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when moderator rights were assigned. Required for audit and permission review. For example, 2024-07-22T15:15:48+09:00.

plainFields.name: revoked_at
plainFields.description: Datetime moderator rights were revoked (if applicable). Required for tracking ongoing and former moderators. Null if currently moderator.

models.name: discussionboard_admins
models.description:
Discussion Board Admin Entity - Implements admin account business requirement for the Actors domain.

Stores system-level platform administrators with permissions to manage users, moderators, board configuration, and compliance. Maintains 3NF by separating admin core data from member entity. Used for assignment of roles, escalation handling, platform oversight.

Key relationships: can be referenced by discussionboard_moderators (as grantor), and linked to audit logs/history for actions.
Special behaviors: Unique email per admin, and activity audit trail.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the discussion board admin.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin's email address. Implements requirement for admin authentication and notification. Unique among administrators. For example, 'admin@platform.com'.

plainFields.name: username
plainFields.description: Admin username for system login and identification. Implements requirement for admin actions attribution. Unique, non-null within admins only. For example, 'supermod'.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for admin secure authentication. Implements authentication and audit requirements. Value is not plaintext password.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of admin account creation. Required for onboarding audit and compliance logging.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of latest admin profile/account update. For precise audit trail per 3NF.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Datetime admin account was soft deleted. Null if current; set if removed per retention policy.

models.name: discussionboard_member_profiles
models.description:
Discussion Board Member Profile Entity - Implements the member profile extension requirement from 02_discussionboard_user_roles_and_journeys.md.

Stores extended profile information (display name, bio, preferences) for each member, separated for normalization and privacy. Maintains strict 3NF; profile details are not stored in core member entity. For example, allows null bio for new accounts, or diverse locales. Used to enrich user experience and for search/discovery features.

Key relationships: Each profile is tied to a member by 1:1 FK; referenced for displaying user info on posts and comments. Profile can be updated separately from account.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for member profile.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_member_id
foreignFields.description: FK to {@link discussionboard_members.id} - the member whose profile this is. Implements 1:1 mapping between member and profile.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Display name visible on posts/comments. Implements requirement for user-facing identification separate from username. Nullable to support privacy settings.

plainFields.name: bio
plainFields.description: Profile bio or introduction text. Implements enrich profile/expression requirement. Nullable for members who do not provide a bio.

plainFields.name: avatar_url
plainFields.description: Public avatar image link for the member profile. Separate from core account for normalization. Nullable for users without avatars.

plainFields.name: locale
plainFields.description: ISO code for user's UI language/locale setting. For internationalization. Nullable.

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: User's preferred timezone (IANA tz format, e.g., "Asia/Seoul"). Supports correct timestamp conversion for notifications. Nullable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when the profile was created. Required for audit trail and compliance.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last profile update time. Tracks modifications, used for search/sorting features.

models.name: discussionboard_member_histories
models.description:
Member History Change/Audit Entity - Implements compliance, audit trail, and profile change history requirements.

Tracks all significant changes for each member: profile updates, role changes, suspensions, and other actions. Supports platform audit, allows admin to review history. Maintains 3NF by referencing the affected member by FK with no redundant data.

Key relationships: many-to-one with discussionboard_members (each member has multiple history entries), referenced during compliance reviews.
Special behaviors: History is immutable; original event data is always preserved.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for member history record.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_member_id
foreignFields.description: FK to {@link discussionboard_members.id} - the member whose change history is recorded. Implements requirement for cross-entity audit trails.

plainFields.name: change_type
plainFields.description: Type of change (e.g., 'profile_update', 'role_granted', 'suspended'). Implements requirement for event categorization and review. Normalized: not repeated elsewhere.

plainFields.name: change_data
plainFields.description: JSON-encoded structured details about the change - Implements additional context for the history event. For example, old/new values in a profile update. Supports audit compliance.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the history entry was created (i.e., when the action occurred). For audit trail and compliance.

models.name: discussionboard_boards
models.description:
Board entity - This implements the requirement for organizing discussions by separate boards (see requirements: Introduction, Service Scope, and Core Functional Requirements on board-level categorization). 

Business explanation: Represents a dedicated board (such as 'General Politics', 'Economics', 'International Affairs') to group threads according to subject or purpose. Supports separation of discussion topics and board-level access control, moderation, and configuration.
Maintains 3NF compliance by isolating board attributes from threads/posts. For example, a new 'Elections 2025' board can be created without modifying thread or post tables.

Key relationships: Will be referenced by thread, post, and moderation policy models in other domains/files. 
Special behaviors: Board can be activated/deactivated, may contain links to policies or display features.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each board entity.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Board name - Implements the board labeling requirement. Human-readable title for the board, e.g., 'Global Economy'. Enforces normalization by being atomic (1NF). Example: Shown at top of board view.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Board description - Implements the requirement for clear labeling and explanation of purpose. Supplies a summary that users see when browsing available boards. Ensures normalization as a direct attribute. Example: 'Discuss world economic trends and data.'

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether the board is currently active/visible. Implements access control requirement. Directly managed by admins. Example: Board may be deactivated during policy reviews.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp - Implements audit logging requirement. Records when the board was established. Ensures integrity for audit purposes. Example: Used in admin logs.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last updated timestamp for the board (implements audit & compliance requirements). Updated any time board configuration changes. Example: Tracks admin updates to board settings.

models.name: discussionboard_board_tags
models.description:
Board-level tag entity - Implements the tag taxonomy management requirement for boards (see requirements: Core Functional Requirements, Tagging & Discovery section). 

Business explanation: Allows boards to be associated with predefined or user-curated tags for improved sorting, searchability, and discovery. Maintains normalized tag assignments; tags may be used for search, recommendations, or access filtering.
3NF compliance is maintained by isolating tag data from boards and other entities.

Key relationships: Will reference discussionboard_boards (via foreign key). May be referenced by search/index systems. 
Special behaviors: Duplicate tag names per board are prevented by composite unique constraint.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Uniquely identifies each board tag entry.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_board_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced board's {@link discussionboard_boards.id} - links tag to a specific board. Supports 1:N assignment of tags to boards.

plainFields.name: tag
plainFields.description: The tag value (e.g., 'Policy', 'Debate') assigned to this board. Implements tag requirement for cross-board discovery and sorting. Example: Used as filter in board search lists. Normalization: atomic and unique within board context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this tag was created or assigned to the board. Implements audit and compliance traceability. For example, supports querying recent tag additions.

models.name: discussionboard_board_categories
models.description:
Board categorization entity - Implements the requirement for supporting hierarchical or topical categorization of boards (see: Service Scope and Tagging/Discovery requirements). 

Business explanation: Allows admins to group boards under broader categories (such as 'Politics', 'Economics', 'Society'), enabling multi-board discovery, filtering, and reporting. Maintains 3NF: category metadata is not duplicated within boards.

Key relationships: Referenced by boards (each board can reference a category), and by reporting modules.
Special behaviors: Category names must be globally unique.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for board category.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: The display name for the category (e.g., 'Economics', 'Global Affairs'). Implements category organization. Normalization: atomic per category. Used for board filtering and analytics. Example: Shown as section label in board list.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Textual description of the category. Implements requirements for informative labeling. Example: 'Boards focused on regional and global market issues.' Normalization: atomic, nullable if not needed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for audit and traceability of board categories.

models.name: discussionboard_board_features
models.description:
Board feature flag entity - Implements the requirement for flexible configuration of board-level features (see: Core Functional Requirements, System Configuration, and Feature/Interaction Controls). 

Business explanation: Stores the enabled state of optional/experimental features on a per-board basis (e.g., can polls be posted, are reactions enabled, is anonymous posting allowed for this board?). Supports fine-grained feature rollout, A/B testing, or customized board behavior. Maintains 3NF: each feature assignment is atomic, attributes are not duplicated within board records.

Key relationships: Points to a board via foreign key. Used by admin/config UI. Referenced by runtime configuration code.
Special behaviors: Board id + feature_key must be unique; prevents duplicate assignments per board/feature.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for this specific feature flag assignment.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_board_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced board's {@link discussionboard_boards.id} - specifies which board's feature is being set.

plainFields.name: feature_key
plainFields.description: Feature key string (e.g., 'enable_polls', 'anonymous_comments') - specifies which feature this record controls. Implements requirement for modular, extensible feature toggling. Example: Used to check board capabilities in code. Normalization: atomic and unique per board.

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Whether the feature is enabled on the associated board. Implements per-board feature flexibility and configuration management. Example: If false, UI disables poll creation for the board.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this feature flag was created. Implements audit and compliance requirements. For example, examining enabling/disabling of sensitive board features over time.

models.name: discussionboard_threads
models.description: Discussion threads for the board - This implements requirements from 03_discussionboard_core_functional_requirements.md and 05_discussionboard_system_workflow_and_moderation_process.md. Provides the primary structure for aggregating posts and comments under a topic/theme. Maintains 3NF compliance: strictly stores only normalized data for the thread (no calculated fields). For example, a member creates a new thread, which is then referenced by posts and followed by others. Key relationships: referenced by follower and snapshot tables, and indirectly by discussionboard_posts, etc., in other domains. Special behaviors: Thread can be soft-deleted or archived, and supports search/tag/category relationships via references in other schemas.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: board_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged board's {@link discussionboard_boards.id}. Links thread to the parent board. Required for associating thread context and policy.

foreignFields.name: creator_member_id
foreignFields.description: Creator's {@link discussionboard_members.id}. References the authoring member for auditing and permissions.

foreignFields.name: category_id
foreignFields.description: Category's {@link discussionboard_board_categories.id}. Associates thread with a board-level category for browsing and filtering.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the discussion thread - Implements the display and searchability requirements. Human-readable, indexed for search.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Thread description or prompt - Implements content-rich initiation of discussion, markdown and media supported (but no storage here; attachments via relations).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Thread status (e.g. 'active', 'archived', 'hidden', 'pending') - Supports workflow in moderation and visibility per business rules.

plainFields.name: is_pinned
plainFields.description: Whether the thread is pinned to the top - Implements requirement for important conversations to be highlighted by moderators/admins.

plainFields.name: is_locked
plainFields.description: Whether the thread is locked (no new posts/comments allowed) - Implements moderation/state transition requirement.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the thread was created - Fulfills audit and sorting requirements. Immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when thread metadata was last changed - Enables recency sorting, edit detection, and audit trail.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When set, indicates the thread is soft-deleted (hidden from users but visible to mods/admins for audit and compliance) - Satisfies data retention policy. Null if not deleted.

plainFields.name: archived_at
plainFields.description: When set, indicates the thread is archived (read-only, but not deleted). Implements post-lifecycle requirements for compliance/audit. Null if not archived.

plainFields.name: last_activity_at
plainFields.description: Last activity timestamp - For thread sort order and engagement metrics. Not a calculated field; updated by triggers/actions.

models.name: discussionboard_thread_snapshots
models.description: Thread snapshot entity - Implements audit and compliance requirements from 03_discussionboard_core_functional_requirements.md and 04_discussionboard_nonfunctional_and_policy_requirements.md. Stores normalized historical copies of thread metadata. Maintains 3NF by ensuring all data depends on the snapshot's unique identity, not introducing calculated fields. For example, when a thread's title or status changes, a new snapshot is recorded for traceability. Key relationship: Linked to the original thread; allows rollback/restore for legal or admin review. Special behaviors: Immutable once created.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: thread_id
foreignFields.description: Target thread's {@link discussionboard_threads.id}. Connects this snapshot to the original thread.

foreignFields.name: editor_member_id
foreignFields.description: Editing member's {@link discussionboard_members.id}. Identifies the member who triggered the snapshot (edit, moderation, etc.).

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Thread title at snapshot time - Stores exact value of title as it was. Ensures 3NF; not duplicated beyond this time slice.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Thread body at snapshot time - Captures thread description or prompt as it was before/after edit/mod. 3NF: Atomic per snapshot.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Thread status at snapshot time (e.g., 'active', 'archived', etc.) - Enables changeset review for audit and compliance.

plainFields.name: is_pinned
plainFields.description: Pinned flag at this snapshot - Allows forensic review of thread's highlighted state history.

plainFields.name: is_locked
plainFields.description: Locked flag at this snapshot - Shows whether the thread was closed to comments/posts at this moment.

plainFields.name: taken_at
plainFields.description: When this snapshot was captured - Timeline anchor for audit logs and rollback features.

models.name: discussionboard_thread_follows
models.description: Entity tracking users following threads - Implements notification and engagement requirements from 03_discussionboard_core_functional_requirements.md. Strictly normalized: records each (follower, thread) pair with audit data but no aggregate/cached fields. For example, members follow threads to receive updates. Key relationships: references both member and thread tables; connected to notification mechanisms in another domain. Special behaviors: members cannot follow the same thread twice; soft-deletion allows for undos or compliance with erasure requests.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: thread_id
foreignFields.description: Followed thread's {@link discussionboard_threads.id}. Connects the follower to the thread.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Follower's {@link discussionboard_members.id}. Connects the action to a specific registered member.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when follow action was created - Fulfills audit and engagement analytics requirements. Atomic per action.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when follow action was undone (unfollowed or upon account/thread deletion). Implements right to erasure and compliance. Null if not deleted.

models.name: discussionboard_posts
models.description: Discussion Post - Implements the main board content creation, visibility, and moderation requirements. Each row represents a user-created post, with atomic structure and all denormalized aspects such as comment count, like counts, and calculated metrics fully excluded as per 3NF normalization. Posts are linked by foreign keys to their authors and the thread they belong to, enabling complete audit trails and referential integrity.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: author_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link discussionboard_members.id}. Identifies the author of the post, maintaining referential integrity to Actors domain.

foreignFields.name: thread_id
foreignFields.description: Thread's {@link discussionboard_threads.id}. Captures the thread which groups multiple posts as a single discussion timeline.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Post title. Concise headline to describe the post subject.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Rich-text/markdown body. Atomic representation of main post content.

plainFields.name: is_published
plainFields.description: Publication state. True if public, false if draft or pending moderation.

plainFields.name: published_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of first publication, present only if published. Fulfills requirements for timeline and feed ordering.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp, nullable. Set when author/moderator requests deletion but content must remain for continuity/audit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Insertion/audit creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Atomic update timestamp. Set to latest edit, always enforced on atomic graphical or content edit.

models.name: discussionboard_post_edit_histories
models.description: Post Edit History - Each edit of a post (by author, moderator, or admin) is recorded here as an atomic snapshot, fulfilling traceability and audit requirements for compliance and transparency. Designed as a historical log, fully normalized and versioned. No denormalized calculated data.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link discussionboard_posts.id}.

foreignFields.name: editor_id
foreignFields.description: Responsible member's {@link discussionboard_members.id}. References member or moderator who made the change.

plainFields.name: old_title
plainFields.description: Value before edit (title).

plainFields.name: old_body
plainFields.description: Value before edit (body).

plainFields.name: edit_reason
plainFields.description: Edit reason or policy justification note.

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of edit. Required for audit trails.

models.name: discussionboard_post_likes
models.description: Post Likes - Each member liking a particular post has one atomic row per (member, post), enforcing single-like-per-user. Normalized so no aggregate counts are stored. Relates posts and members.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Target Post's {@link discussionboard_posts.id}.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Liking member's {@link discussionboard_members.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of like event.

models.name: discussionboard_post_dislikes
models.description: Post Dislikes - Each member disliking a post creates a record per (member, post), preventing duplicate dislikes. Normalized; used for counting or abuse detection analytics outside this model.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link discussionboard_posts.id}.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Disliking member's {@link discussionboard_members.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of dislike event.

models.name: discussionboard_post_reports
models.description: Post Reports - Every instance of a member reporting a post for policy violation, with all atomic details provided to ensure 3NF and normalization. Each row links reporter-member and post, and holds structured reason code and optional free-text evidence, as well as resolution tracking. No denormalized outcome/aggregate data is recorded here.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link discussionboard_posts.id}.

foreignFields.name: reporter_id
foreignFields.description: Reporting member's {@link discussionboard_members.id}.

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Reason code (enum/short string): e.g., 'spam', 'abuse', 'misinfo'.

plainFields.name: reason_text
plainFields.description: Free text evidence or explanation. Optional.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (audit).

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: Moderator/admin action completion time. Null if unresolved.

models.name: discussionboard_post_attachments
models.description: Post Attachments - Every asset attached to a post is referenced here. No BLOB/file data is stored, only file URIs and metadata. Enforces referential integrity to posts but does not link to users. Normalized structure only.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Post's {@link discussionboard_posts.id}.

plainFields.name: file_uri
plainFields.description: Canonical URI/path to the file asset (may be internal or external repro).

plainFields.name: file_name
plainFields.description: Original filename at upload.

plainFields.name: mime_type
plainFields.description: File content-type, e.g., 'application/pdf', 'image/png'.

plainFields.name: uploaded_at
plainFields.description: File timestamp at upload.

models.name: discussionboard_post_tags
models.description: Post Tags - Junction table that maintains many-to-many relationship between posts and tags. Each row connects one post with one tag. Enforces unique constraint so tags cannot be duplicated per post. For tag information see Boards domain.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Owning post's {@link discussionboard_posts.id}.

foreignFields.name: tag_id
foreignFields.description: Tag's {@link discussionboard_board_tags.id} - reference in Boards domain.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of tagging event.

models.name: discussionboard_comments
models.description: Discussion board comment entity - Implements comment-management and threading requirements from the platform RDD (incl. reply/nesting/audit). Each comment is tied to a post, a member (author), and optionally to another comment (for replies). Strict 3NF: all data is atomic, no duplication, all relations explicit. Used for creating, editing, replying, displaying, soft-deletion, and moderation/abuse tracing. Example: A member leaves a comment on a post, which may itself be a reply to another comment.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Serves as the unique identifier for the comment record.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_post_id
foreignFields.description: Parent post's {@link discussionboard_posts.id} - Links this comment to the post under which it appears. Mandatory for proper placement in the post hierarchy.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_member_id
foreignFields.description: Author's {@link discussionboard_members.id} - References the member who authored the comment.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent comment's {@link discussionboard_comments.id} - Nullable for top-level comments. Enables threaded discussion structure.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Comment text body. Contains the user-authored text or markdown submitted as the comment's main content. Example: 'I agree with your point, ...'

plainFields.name: deleted
plainFields.description: Whether the comment is soft-deleted. Supports audit and discussion continuity by marking as deleted but retaining record. For example, deleted comments appear as 'This comment has been removed.'

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created. Indicates exact creation time and enables strict ordering.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was last changed (edit, delete, restore, etc.). Used for edit windows, change history, and synchronization.

models.name: discussionboard_comment_edit_histories
models.description: Comment edit history (snapshot) - Implements the audit logging requirement for comment edits. Each record represents a single edit to a comment, storing the full text as it existed at that edit. References both the comment and editor (in case moderator/staff performed correction). Strictly normalized: edits are not stored inline on main table, each edit is a new row. Enables audit trails, rollback, and viewing edit history, without denormalization.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment being edited.

foreignFields.name: edited_by_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who performed this edit (may differ from original author).

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Snapshot text of comment at time of this edit. Allows historical review and change tracking.

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: When the edit was made. Enables ordering of edit history and audit trail.

models.name: discussionboard_comment_likes
models.description: Comment like action record. Corresponds to individual member's 'like' on a particular comment. Implements requirements for like/dislike granularity and auditability. Each like is its own row for normalization (not a counter). Uniqueness enforced for member+comment. Used for analytics, abuse prevention, reputation calculation. No aggregate/calculated fields in this table, only links and timestamp.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_comment_id
foreignFields.description: The comment being liked (target).

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_member_id
foreignFields.description: The member performing the like action.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when like was set. Used for analytics and audit.

models.name: discussionboard_comment_dislikes
models.description: Dislike action record for comments. Fulfills requirement for member-level dislike tracking & abuse detection. Each record represents a member's single negative reaction to a comment; no aggregation/denormalization. Uniqueness constraint member+comment prevents duplicate dislikes. Strict normalization and audit compliance.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_comment_id
foreignFields.description: The comment being disliked.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_member_id
foreignFields.description: The member performing the dislike action.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the dislike was set. Enables timeline analysis and audit.

models.name: discussionboard_comment_reports
models.description: Comment report (flag) - Implements moderation and abuse workflow for individual comments. Records a member-generated report against a specific comment for review. Strictly normalized: can have multiple reports per member and comment (for various reasons/times). Supports compliance, anti-abuse, moderation tracing, and escalation. No aggregation/precalculation here. All moderator actions, resolutions, and workflows occur in moderation tables.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_comment_id
foreignFields.description: The comment being reported.

foreignFields.name: discussionboard_member_id
foreignFields.description: The member making this report.

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Reason preset code (e.g., 'spam', 'harassment', 'copyright', etc). Controlled by content policy configuration, see moderation domain.

plainFields.name: reason_details
plainFields.description: Detailed description (optional) entered by reporting member to explain or provide evidence. Only used for moderator context/notifying.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the report was created/submitted.

models.name: discussionboard_reports
models.description: Report Event Entity - Implements reporting/flagging per requirements, normalizing all report event data. Key for audit trail, policy enforcement, and escalation workflows.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique report event identifier.

foreignFields.name: reporter_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link discussionboard_members.id} (the reporting user).

foreignFields.name: target_post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link discussionboard_posts.id} if report is on a post (null for comment).

foreignFields.name: target_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment's {@link discussionboard_comments.id} if report is on comment (null for post).

plainFields.name: reason_category
plainFields.description: Category for policy violation (e.g., spam, harassment, misinformation). Used for filtering and escalation thresholds.

plainFields.name: reason_details
plainFields.description: Optional details for why the content was reported, supporting moderator context. Normalized, atomic and non-computed.

plainFields.name: is_anonymous
plainFields.description: Whether reporter identity is visible to moderators/administrators. Enables anonymous flagging as per compliance.

plainFields.name: reported_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of report submission. Used for ordering, escalations, and SLA compliance.

models.name: discussionboard_report_histories
models.description: Audit trail of report lifecycle events (status change, moderator assignment, escalation, resolution). Enables end-to-end chronology complying with strict moderation audit needs.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique report history event record.

foreignFields.name: report_id
foreignFields.description: Parent report's {@link discussionboard_reports.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member/moderator/admin who authored this event log {@link discussionboard_members.id}.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of lifecycle event (submitted, assigned, in_review, dismissed, escalated, closed, appealed, etc). Policy-driven codes only.

plainFields.name: event_details
plainFields.description: Additional context or moderator/admin notes. Not for business logic/derived fields - atomic audit only.

plainFields.name: event_timestamp
plainFields.description: Exact time this event occurred for compliance/Audit Log.

models.name: discussionboard_moderation_actions
models.description: Record of all moderation or administrative actions (approve, edit, remove, escalate, warn, ban) driven by reports. Central to moderation workflow, compliance, and user auditing.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique moderation action record.

foreignFields.name: report_id
foreignFields.description: Report {@link discussionboard_reports.id} resulting in action.

foreignFields.name: moderator_member_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator/admin acting user ID {@link discussionboard_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post acted upon {@link discussionboard_posts.id}, nullable for comment/system actions.

foreignFields.name: target_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment acted upon {@link discussionboard_comments.id}, nullable for post/system actions.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Action performed: approve, edit, hide, delete, escalate, warn, ban per audit requirements. No summary/computed func.

plainFields.name: action_details
plainFields.description: Notes describing action rationale. Not a computed/joined field.

plainFields.name: executed_at
plainFields.description: Time of action for compliance/audit.

models.name: discussionboard_bans
models.description: Bans/suspensions resulting from moderation action. Holds record of duration, type, and rationale per event. Acts as a direct child of moderation action, fully normalized.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique ban event identifier.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Banned member's {@link discussionboard_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: Moderation action which generated the ban {@link discussionboard_moderation_actions.id}.

plainFields.name: ban_type
plainFields.description: Type of ban: temporary, permanent, system. As defined by policy codes.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Effective start time of ban event.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration (null if permanent). Separate field for full normalization.

plainFields.name: ban_reason
plainFields.description: Rationale for ban as free text or policy key. Atomic data only.

models.name: discussionboard_warnings
models.description: Unique formal/informal warnings issued to a member via moderation. 3NF by linking only essential data, never duplicating report, member, or moderation_action.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique warning record.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Warned user {@link discussionboard_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: Moderation action which resulted in warning {@link discussionboard_moderation_actions.id}.

plainFields.name: warning_type
plainFields.description: Warning type/policy code (e.g., informal, formal, guideline_violation).

plainFields.name: issued_at
plainFields.description: Warning event timestamp.

plainFields.name: warning_message
plainFields.description: Optional message to user from moderator/admin.

models.name: discussionboard_appeals
models.description: Appeal/request for review of a moderation action (ban, warning, etc.) by a member. 3NF normalized for full auditability and appeal process trace.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique appeal event identifier.

foreignFields.name: appellant_member_id
foreignFields.description: Appellant {@link discussionboard_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: Action being appealed {@link discussionboard_moderation_actions.id}.

foreignFields.name: admin_member_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator handling appeal. Nullable until resolved. {@link discussionboard_members.id}.

plainFields.name: appeal_type
plainFields.description: Type of appeal: ban_appeal, warning_appeal, content_removal_appeal.

plainFields.name: appeal_message
plainFields.description: Submitted message describing grounds for appeal (free text).

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Appeal submission time. For audit and process sequencing.

plainFields.name: resolved_at
